    if = {
        limit = { is_ai = no lyd_c2_current_proposal_trigger = { ACTOR = root } }
        save_scope_as = lyd_c2_actor
        lyd_c2_refresh_snapshot_effect = yes

            limit = { lyd_c2_ready_to_confirm_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:lyd_c2_actor } }
            if = { limit = { var:lyd_c2_kind = 1 } lyd_c2_commit_join_effect = yes }
            else = { lyd_c2_commit_detach_effect = yes }
        }
    }
}
lyd_c2_commit_join_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { is_ai = no lyd_c2_ready_to_confirm_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:lyd_c2_actor } var:lyd_c2_kind = 1 }
        # Quoted argument syntax cannot interpolate an ACTOR variable path.
        # Bind the actual captured receiving main Rite before any mutation.
        var:lyd_c2_target_main = { save_scope_as = lyd_c2_native_target_main }
        # PRE-change singleton snapshot; migration may create a backup main rite.
        lyd_c2_retire_source_head_effect = yes
        if = { limit = { lyd_c2_retirement_postcondition_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:lyd_c2_actor } }
            var:lyd_c2_moving_rite = {
                lyd_c3_before_rite_migration_effect = yes
                lyd_c3_cleanup_rite_claim_offices_effect = yes
                set_parent_faith = { target = scope:lyd_c2_actor.var:lyd_c2_target_faith main = no include_derived = no }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    var:lyd_c2_moving_rite = {
                        faith = scope:lyd_c2_actor.var:lyd_c2_target_faith
                        this != faith.main_rite
                        "divergence(scope:lyd_c2_native_target_main)" < 100
                    }
                    var:lyd_c2_target_faith = { main_rite = scope:lyd_c2_actor.var:lyd_c2_target_main }
                    lyd_c2_retirement_postcondition_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:lyd_c2_actor }
                    trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = lyd_c2_target_head }
                        var:lyd_c2_target_faith.religious_head = var:lyd_c2_target_head
                    }
                }
                var:lyd_c2_moving_rite = { set_variable = { name = lyd_c2_transition_cooldown value = 1 days = 1825 } }
                remove_short_term_gold = 300
                add_piety = -1500
                set_variable = { name = lyd_c2_result value = 1 }
                change_variable = { name = lyd_c2_completed_joins add = 1 }
                lyd_c2_reconcile_after_transition_effect = yes
                lyd_c2_release_locks_effect = yes
                trigger_event = lyd.228
            }
            else = { lyd_c2_native_failure_effect = yes }
        }
        else = { lyd_c2_native_failure_effect = yes }
    }
}
lyd_c2_commit_detach_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { is_ai = no lyd_c2_ready_to_confirm_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:lyd_c2_actor } var:lyd_c2_kind = 2 }
        # Character-scoped invocation plus saved returned Faith, as in R0002.
        var:lyd_c2_moving_rite = {
            lyd_c3_before_rite_migration_effect = yes
            lyd_c3_cleanup_rite_claim_offices_effect = yes
        }
        detach_rite_to_new_faith = { target = var:lyd_c2_moving_rite save_scope_as = lyd_c2_new_faith }
        lyd_c2_create_owned_temporal_head_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                exists = scope:lyd_c2_new_faith
                faith = scope:lyd_c2_new_faith
                var:lyd_c2_moving_rite = { faith = scope:lyd_c2_new_faith this = faith.main_rite }
                var:lyd_c2_source_faith = { main_rite = scope:lyd_c2_actor.var:lyd_c2_source_main }
                OR = {
                    AND = { rite = { rite_has_doctrine = doctrine_no_head } faith = { NOT = { exists = religious_head_title } } }
                    AND = {
                        rite = { rite_has_doctrine = doctrine_temporal_head }
                        faith.religious_head = scope:lyd_c2_actor
                        faith.religious_head_title = { has_variable = lyd_c2_owned_head_title var:lyd_c2_owner_faith = scope:lyd_c2_new_faith }
                    }
                }
            }
            var:lyd_c2_moving_rite = { set_variable = { name = lyd_c2_transition_cooldown value = 1 days = 1825 } }
            remove_short_term_gold = 200
            add_piety = -1000
            set_variable = { name = lyd_c2_result value = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = lyd_c2_completed_detaches add = 1 }
            lyd_c2_reconcile_after_transition_effect = yes
            lyd_c2_release_locks_effect = yes
            trigger_event = lyd.228
        }
        else = { lyd_c2_native_failure_effect = yes }
    }
}
lyd_c2_native_failure_effect = {
    # Preserve actual partial state and record failure; never fabricate rollback.
    set_variable = { name = lyd_c2_result value = 5 }
    debug_log = "LYD_C2_NATIVE_POSTCONDITION_FAILED"
    debug_log_scopes = yes
    lyd_c2_reconcile_after_transition_effect = yes
    lyd_c2_release_locks_effect = yes
    trigger_event = lyd.228
}
lyd_c2_reconcile_after_transition_effect = {
    if = { limit = { exists = var:lyd_c2_source_faith }
        var:lyd_c2_source_faith = { lyd_c3_reconcile_faith_roles_effect = yes }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = lyd_c2_target_faith exists = var:lyd_c2_target_faith }
        var:lyd_c2_target_faith = { lyd_c3_reconcile_faith_roles_effect = yes }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:lyd_c2_new_faith }
        scope:lyd_c2_new_faith = { lyd_c3_reconcile_faith_roles_effect = yes }
    }
}
